text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗢𝗨𝗧 𝟴𝟵! 😳🇮🇳

New Zealand win the 4th ODI by 244 runs (333 v 89).
Matt Henry 6/27; Will Young 125. India's second-biggest ODI defeat by runs.

Series still 2-1. Bounce back? 👇

#INDvNZ #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝟴𝟵 𝗠𝗔𝗜𝗡 𝗦𝗔𝗠𝗔𝗣𝗧! 😳🇮🇳

👉 New Zealand ne 4th ODI 244 runs se jeeta (NZ 333, India 89)
👉 Matt Henry ke 6/27, Will Young ke 125 runs
👉 ODI mein runs ke hisaab se India ki doosri sabse badi haar
👉 Series ab bhi India ke naam 2-1 se, aakhri ODI Sunday ko

India ka comeback hoga ya NZ barabari karega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
